description: This is a Kotlin test source file for the HttpManager class, testing HTTP download functionalities including request headers, ETag checks, download resumption, mirror fallback, proxy application, and error handling.

classes.name: HttpManagerTest
classes.description: Test class for HttpManager, containing multiple test cases for HTTP download, headers, error handling, and proxy configurations.

methods.name: testUserAgent
methods.description: Tests that the User-Agent header is correctly set in requests.

methods.name: testQueryString
methods.description: Tests that query parameters are correctly included in requests.

methods.name: testBasicAuth
methods.description: Tests that basic authentication headers are correctly set.

methods.name: testHeadETagCheck
methods.description: Tests ETag handling in HEAD requests to detect changes.

methods.name: testDownload
methods.description: Tests downloading content and verifying data integrity.

methods.name: testResumeDownload
methods.description: Tests resuming downloads with byte range requests.

methods.name: testResumeDownloadWhenMirrorFailOver
methods.description: Tests download resumption fallback when mirror fails (ignored in current test).

methods.name: testMirrorFallback
methods.description: Tests fallback to other mirrors on server error.

methods.name: testFirstMirrorSuccess
methods.description: Tests that the first successful mirror is used.

methods.name: testNoMoreMirrorsWhenForbiddenWithCredentials
methods.description: Tests behavior when access is forbidden with credentials, ensuring no further mirrors are tried.

methods.name: testNoMoreMirrorsWhenRepoDownloadNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when a resource is not found, ensuring no further mirrors are tried.

methods.name: testNoRedirect
methods.description: Tests that redirects are not followed and appropriate exceptions are thrown.

methods.name: testProxyGetsApplied
methods.description: Tests that proxy settings are correctly applied when creating HTTP engines.

methods.name: testNoProxyWithLocalMirror
methods.description: Tests that local mirrors bypass proxy settings.
